title: A törvényalkotás menete és a népszavazás (The Legislative Pathway & Direct Democracy)
grammar: Institutional Governance, Separation of Powers & Public Law in Hungarian

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can describe in simple words how a bill becomes a law in Hungary.
I can say where a law is officially published.
I can say how many voters can start a national referendum.
I can read a short text about lawmaking and referendums.
